property_summary: For any positive ETH amount held by C, calling withdrawAll() as the owner must transfer C's entire balance out so that address(c).balance becomes 0 and the owner (this test contract) receives that amount; the mutant keeps the funds, leaving address(c).balance nonzero for the same input.
change_summary: Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds.
